research_question: Can causal trade-tape structure add a robust same-day edge beyond the previously tested price and tick-flow confirmation rules?
technical_corrections_before_performance: The first replay invocation stopped before selection or PnL because lit_flow_imbalance existed in both the established flow cache and the new tape cache, causing pandas merge suffixes. The tape merge was restricted to new columns only; no rule, threshold, rank, clock, or portfolio setting changed.

data_contract.universe: quarterly PIT market-cap top500 intersected with daily PIT eligibility and ADV20 >= 10m; price >= 5; abs gap <= 30%
data_contract.precandidates: previous-day open-to-15:55 return <= -5% OR opening gap >= +2%; old/manual 62 unused
data_contract.signal_clock: only Polygon trades with SIP timestamp in [09:30,10:00) ET; entry is exact 10:05 open
data_contract.exit: exact 15:55 close; post-selection 16:00 open fallback only
data_contract.opening_proxy: trade condition codes 16, 17, 25, and 55; this is opening-print participation, not auction imbalance
data_contract.large_trade: fixed as-printed trade dollar >= 100000, frozen without outcome inspection
data_contract.quotes: historical NBBO unavailable under current entitlement; no spread or quote imbalance claim

variants.name: yday_large_lit_sponsorship
variants.rule: YDAY crash/reclaim plus large-lit signed-dollar imbalance >= 0.10 and fixed-$100k trade share >= 5%
variants.rank: prior loss times one plus large-lit imbalance

variants.name: yday_broad_venue_confirmation
variants.rule: YDAY crash/reclaim plus positive lit flow, at least five exchanges, and exchange-dollar HHI <= 0.35
variants.rank: prior loss times venue breadth and inverse concentration

variants.name: yday_opening_print_absorption
variants.rule: YDAY crash/reclaim plus opening-condition prints >= 1% of dollars, their VWAP >=20 bps below 30m VWAP, and positive large-lit flow
variants.rank: prior loss times opening discount and large-lit imbalance

variants.name: gapup_large_lit_sponsorship
variants.rule: gap-up confirmation plus large-lit signed-dollar imbalance >= 0.10 and fixed-$100k trade share >= 5%
variants.rank: gap/price confirmation times one plus large-lit imbalance

variants.name: gapup_sweep_confirmation
variants.rule: gap-up confirmation plus positive lit flow, intermarket-sweep share >= 1%, and exchange-dollar HHI <= 0.45
variants.rank: gap/price confirmation times sweep share and lit flow

portfolio.selection: up to three highest-ranked longs per day after exact-entry filtering and full refill
portfolio.sic_cap: maximum one ticker per SIC per day
portfolio.weight: 20% current NAV per name; maximum 0.6x entry gross

development_gate.winner: highest base-cost Sharpe then CAGR among passers

multiple_testing_policy: Exactly five frozen rows. No post-result threshold, rank, clock, exit, direction, or position-count changes.
production_policy: A validation pass permits further audit only, not production PASS.
